speaker: Doctor
text:
I notice you mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To better understand your current condition, can you tell me if you have noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, frequency, or the presence of blood?

Also, have you experienced any nausea or vomiting alongside these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. Did you experience burning sensation during urination or pass any visible blood in your urine? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture.
